'''Sandi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and con artist on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. She was trying to make a name for herself through the club owner [[Orman]] whom she worked for as a thug, however few of his other employees took her seriously. She spent the majority of here life living on the streets of [[Lola Curich]] and liked it this way. At some point during her employment she was ordered to attack a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents.
